# Folded open-cutter native control

QuickSurface Pro 8.0.123 imported both STL meshes in millimetres, split the selected source with the folded cutter with Envelope off, Preview then OK. The source changed from 2 to 11 triangles, with one individual mesh and one hole shown. The cutter was hidden before exporting the source; the native project retains both objects. Its indexed source has 9 vertices, 11 faces, boundary length 8, and both faces share each indexed edge along the tested folded path. The exported STL facets match the indexed QSF facets. The shared application operation now matches the native exported facet multiset and shared-edge boundary for this input; other folded inputs remain unverified.
